## Projects

::: {.cv-entry}
### Credit Risk Model Updating

2026 · R

- Compared recalibration and refitting on **three Fannie Mae cohorts** comprising approximately **1.55 million eligible loans**, with separate development, adaptation, and temporal test cohorts.
- Evaluated updating and regularization across **22,500 simulated datasets** and five validation allocations, measuring performance on independent test samples.
- Examined how label budgets, shift mechanisms, and regularization changed the relative performance of updating policies.
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
### Fire Loss Modeling and Tail Diagnostics

2026 · R

- Analyzed approximately **1.25 million positive-loss records** from NFIRS 2016–2025 using Peaks-Over-Threshold and Generalized Pareto models to estimate Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall.
- Compared empirical and fitted expectations within bounded loss layers; assessed uncertainty by incident-cluster bootstrap and examined sensitivity to exceptional records.
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
### shiftadapt

R package · In development

- Implemented **four updating strategies**: retention, intercept recalibration, intercept-and-slope recalibration, and full refitting.
- Separated fitting, validation, and test samples for minimum-log-loss and paired one-standard-error selection.
:::
